level.CONFIRM: observed mean log eps_final inside ci_log_eps for that target and k
level.MISS: outside the CI; report as a systematic level deviation (itself a boundary-of-validity result), NOT re-fit

decision_criteria.overall: Arm G is UPSIDE, not foundation: the paper's claims stand on the framework + the in-hand 70/160/410M triptych regardless of this forecast's outcome. A clean non-monotone level with honest CIs is an acceptable and interesting result.

structural.ATTENUATE: beta in [0.20, 0.35) (LSTM-like deformation) with H monotone in log(T/k)
structural.CONFIRM: per-arm fitted slope beta in [0.35, 0.65] AND both k-point H within confirm_band
structural.FAIL: beta < 0.20 or non-monotone H or H outside 2x the confirm_band
